nodes.statement: \begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~\ref{main}] If $G$ is an acyclic mixed graph, then by Lemma \ref{phisum},\begin{eqnarray*}\chi_G(-k) &=& \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^m \phi_{G_i}(-k) \\&=& \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^m \Omega_{P_i,\omega_i}(-k) \ \text{ (by Lemma \ref{labeling})}\\&=& \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^m (-1)^{|P_i|}\Omega_{P_i,\overline{\omega_i}}(k) \ \text{ (by Theorem \ref{stanley_op})}\\&=& (-1)^{|V|}\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^m \Omega_{P_i,\overline{\omega_i}}(k) \, . \end{eqnarray*}By applying Lemma \ref{labeling} again, the proof is completed.\end{proof}
